title: Novel O-benzylcinnamic acid derivative L26 treats acute lung injury in mice by MD-2.
authors: Li, Xiang; Yin, Lina; Liao, Jing; Yang, Jun; Cai, Binhao; Yu, Yiming; Su, Sijia; Du, Zhiteng; Li, Xiaobo; Zhou, Ying; Chen, Pan; Cho, Won-Jea; Chattipakorn, Nipon; Samorodov, Aleksandr V; Pavlov, Valentin N; Zhang, Fengzhi; Liang, Guang; Tang, Qidong
one_liner_zh: 该文研究小分子化合物L26靶向MD-2蛋白治疗急性肺损伤，属于药物化学与炎症机制研究，不涉及蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA结合建模，与本课题无关。
abstract: Acute lung injury (ALI) is an inflammation-mediated respiratory disease that is associated with a high mortality rate. In this study, a series of novel O-benzylcinnamic acid derivatives were designed and synthesized using cinnamic acid as the lead compound. We tested the preliminary anti-inflammatory activity of the compounds by evaluating their effect on inhibiting the activity of alkaline phosphatase (ALP) in Hek-Blue-TLR4 cells, in which compound L26 showed the best activity and 7-fold more active than CIN. ELISA, immunoprecipitation, and molecular docking indicated that L26 targeted MD-2 protein and competed with LPS to bind to MD-2, which resulted in the inhibition of inflammation. In the LPS-induced mouse model of ALI, L26 was found to decrease ALP activity and inflammatory cytokine TNF-alpha release to reduce lung injury by inhibiting the NF-kappaB signaling pathway. Acute toxicity experiments showed that high doses of L26 did not cause adverse reactions in mice, and it was safe in vivo. Also, the preliminary pharmacokinetic parameters of L26 were investigated in SD rats (T(1/2) = 4.246 h). In summary, L26 exhibited optimal pharmacodynamic and pharmacokinetic characteristics, which suggested that L26 could serve as a potential agent for the development of ALI treatment.
abstract_zh: 急性肺损伤（ALI）是一种由炎症介导的呼吸系统疾病，与高死亡率相关。本研究以肉桂酸为先导化合物，设计并合成了一系列新型O-苄基肉桂酸衍生物。我们通过评估化合物抑制Hek-Blue-TLR4细胞中碱性磷酸酶（ALP）活性的作用，测试了其初步抗炎活性，其中化合物L26表现出最佳活性，且比CIN强7倍。ELISA、免疫沉淀和分子对接表明，L26靶向MD-2蛋白，并与LPS竞争结合MD-2，从而抑制炎症。在LPS诱导的ALI小鼠模型中，发现L26通过抑制NF-κB信号通路，降低ALP活性和炎症细胞因子TNF-α的释放，从而减轻肺损伤。急性毒性实验显示，高剂量L26未在小鼠中引起不良反应，且在体内安全。此外，初步研究了L26在SD大鼠中的药代动力学参数（T(1/2) = 4.246小时）。总之，L26表现出良好的药效学和药代动力学特性，这表明L26可作为开发ALI治疗的潜在药物。
